incidentsResolved: Headless MV3 verification initially used Playwright's reduced headless shell. Ferrum now uses the full chromium channel for extension-capable headless runs.
Lightpanda through Playwright timed out on Chromium lifecycle expectations. Ferrum now drives Lightpanda through its native CDP server directly.
Parallel runs could collide on evidence directory IDs. Evidence IDs now include a random nonce.
Benchmark warmup 0 was coerced to 1. Explicit zero warmup is now preserved.
Cross-platform checkout line endings produced different fixture hashes. Repository text checkout is normalized to LF and Linux/Windows extension SHA-256 now matches exactly.
nextActions: Use Ferrum in every applicable GameSync extension verification and keep Opera GX as additional compatibility coverage.
Turn real GameSync workflows into reusable Ferrum workload packs as changed features are exercised.
Improve Ferrum whenever testing exposes a reusable speed, reliability, control, or observability problem, then rerun the target workload.
Add richer extension service-worker CDP console/network inspection.
Qualify Electron and Appium lanes against real applications before claiming those lanes fully verified.
